title: Emergent Matter Research Framework (EMRF): Space-Entropy Compression and Multi-Star Relativistic S-Star Dynamics
description: Open-source research framework, numerical simulation platform, and observational astrophysics testing suite investigating the Compressed Space-Time Matter Hypothesis (CSTMH). Implements multidimensional spatial coordinates X = {x, y, z, d0, d1, d2, ...}, thermodynamic entropy state coupling S(X,t), 1PN relativistic equations of motion, exact Kretschmann curvature calculations, Thiele-Innes sky-plane projection, SPARC rotation curve fitting, and cosmological horizon acceleration evolution a_0(z) = c H(z) / (2 pi). Empirically confronted across 425 observational data points spanning the Sagittarius A* S-star cluster (S2, S29, S38, S55, S301; Delta-BIC = +70.74, Branch A Geometric Collapse), 10 SPARC rotationally supported galaxies (Delta-BIC = -52,490.1), and 10 high-redshift JWST/ALMA disk galaxies (Delta-BIC = -100.08). Backed by 99 automated tests.
